stage.title: Move {number} to a stage
stage.body: It is at {stage} now. A CAPA moves either way inside its own stages, and may skip one.

hint.CORRECTIVE: Removes the cause of this problem (D5–D6).
hint.PREVENTIVE: Stops the same problem elsewhere or later (D7).

hint.open: CAPAs and 8Ds not closed or cancelled
hint.actionsOverdue: Open actions past their due day
hint.mine: I own it, I am in the team, or an open action is mine

list.intro: Corrective actions and 8D reports: what they came from, the team, the actions with their reminders, and the report for the customer.
list.noAccessBody: This page needs quality.capa.view. The company's owner or administrator gives it with a role (Admin › Roles & permissions).
list.failed: The corrective actions could not be read
list.noMatchBody: Nothing in these rows matches the filters.
list.noMatchBoard: The board shows {type} only: pick the other type above.
list.emptyBody: Escalate an NCR or a complaint to start one, or start a new CAPA.
list.foot: A tile is a saved row. The board shows one type at a time: CAPA (Plan → Act → Check) or 8D (D1 … D8).

board.closedLane: Drop here to close: the checks and the closing words
board.readOnly: You can see the board; moving a card needs quality.capa.manage.
board.oneType: The board shows one type at a time, its own stages: switch between CAPA and 8D in the toolbar.

held.noManage: This needs quality.capa.manage (quality follows corrective actions up).
held.offline: Offline: changes wait until the connection is back.
held.ACTION_ENDED: The action is {status}: it never changes.
held.NCR_KEEPS_CAPA: {number} is decided or closed: it keeps this CAPA.
held.TOO_MANY_REMINDERS: Reminded {count} times already: no more by hand.
held.NO_REPORT: Keep a version of the 8D first (Keep a version, above).
held.notYourAction: Only quality, or the person who owns the action, records it done.
held.tooManyActions: A CAPA has at most {count} actions.
held.shareOnly8D: Only an 8D is shared with the customer.

refused.FINAL: It is closed or cancelled: it never changes.
refused.NOT_LAST_STAGE: It closes only from its last stage.
refused.ACTION_ENDED: The action is done or cancelled.
refused.NCR_KEEPS_CAPA: The NCR is decided or closed and keeps its CAPA.
refused.OTHER_COMPANY: Another company's record: a CAPA takes the records of its own company.
refused.NO_PERMISSION: Escalating it needs quality.ncr.manage at its site.
refused.NO_CAPA: The complaint names no CAPA or 8D.
refused.NO_REPORT: The 8D has no version kept yet.
refused.other: Not possible in its present state.

problem.stale: Changed by someone else meanwhile: read again, check, and do it once more.
problem.signedOut: Your session ended: sign in again.
problem.forbidden: You may not do this here.
problem.stepUp: This needs a fresh code from your authenticator.
problem.notFound: Not found: it may have been removed.
problem.invalid: Refused: something in it is not valid.
problem.rateLimited: Too many tries: wait a moment.
problem.contract: The answer was not what this page expects: reload the page.
problem.unavailable: The factory did not answer: try again.
problem.internal: Something went wrong on the factory's side: try again.
problem.head: The CAPA
problem.teamHint: The people who work on it, each with their role in the team.
problem.teamFull: At most {count} people in a team.
problem.whatHint: What is wrong, in plain words.
problem.whereHint: The style, line, lot or customer it shows on.
problem.whenHint: Since when, how it was found.
problem.howManyHint: How many pieces, lots or returns.
problem.stageHint: Move it to any stage, either way; Closed asks for the closing words.
problem.sourcesNone: Opened by hand: no NCR or complaint.
problem.sourcesHint: An NCR or a complaint joins with Escalate to CAPA on its own page.
problem.containmentNone: No NCR you can see contains anything for it.
problem.containmentNoActions: No containment action on this NCR.
problem.causesNone: No NCR names a cause yet.

field.title: Say in a few words what it is about.
field.dueOnPast: A new CAPA is due today or later.
field.sourcesCompanies: The records are of two companies: a CAPA takes one company's.
field.teamSize: At most {count} people in a team.
field.teamTwice: Each person once in the team.
field.teamRole: Say this person's role in the team.
field.actionDuePast: An action is due today or later.

field.title: Title
field.ownerId: Owner (an office person who sees this CAPA)
field.customerId: Customer (a customer or a brand of the company)
field.escalateToId: Escalate to (an office person who sees this CAPA)
field.evidenceNote: Evidence: say what was done, or add a file first

new.title: New CAPA
new.heldReading: Still reading the records it comes from.
new.typeHintCapa: An internal corrective action: Plan → Act → Check.
new.typeHint8D: An 8D for a customer: D1 team … D8 closure, with its report.
new.fieldTitleHint: What it is about, in a few words.
new.sourcesHint: Open NCRs and complaints: each names this CAPA once it is created.
new.findSources: Find an NCR or a complaint
new.noFindRight: Finding NCRs or complaints needs quality.ncr.view or quality.complaints.view.
new.ownerHint: An office person who sees CAPAs here.
new.peopleFailed: The people could not be read: you own it.
new.customerHint: Only for a CAPA written for a customer.
new.problemHint: Optional: the rest of the problem statement is on the record.

close.title: Close {number}
close.introCapa: A CAPA closes from Check, once at least one action is done and none is open.
close.intro8D: An 8D closes from D8 closure, once at least one action is done and none is open.
close.noteHint: What was done and how you know it worked.

NO_OPEN_ACTION.no_one: {count} action is still open: finish or cancel it.
NO_OPEN_ACTION.no_other: {count} actions are still open: finish or cancel them.

band.keep: Keep a version of the report

record.offline: Offline: you see the last copy; changes wait until the connection is back.
record.stale: Changed elsewhere at {time} while you worked.

activity.none: The activity opens with the record.

actions.intro: Corrective and preventive actions (D5–D7). The owner is reminded 3 days before and on the due day; an overdue action escalates to its path, else by the company's quality rule.
actions.label: Actions
actions.foot: Enter on a row opens the action beside the list. Changes in a cell save by themselves.

drawer.title: Action {seq} · {kind}
drawer.missingBody: This action is not on the CAPA any more.
drawer.escalateHint: When it is overdue. Left empty: the people of the company's quality rule.
drawer.remindersRule: Sent as a task to the owner {days} days before and on the due day, from {hour}:00.
drawer.reminded: Action {seq}: a reminder is in the owner's tasks
drawer.remindedNobody: Action {seq}: nobody may be given the reminder here

add.title: Add an action to {number}
add.ownerHint: They get the reminders as tasks.

done.title: Action {seq} done
done.heldEvidence: Say what was done, or add a file to the action first.
done.evidenceHint: What was done, and how one can check it.
done.filesThere_one: {count} file of the action is already its evidence; a note is optional.
done.filesThere_other: {count} files of the action are already its evidence; a note is optional.

cancel.title: Cancel {number}
cancel.body: Only for one raised by mistake: its open actions stop and their reminders with them. It never changes after.

removeSource.title: Remove {number}
removeSource.body: The complaint stays as it is; it no longer names this CAPA.
removeSource.bodyNcr: The NCR no longer names this CAPA, and may be escalated again.

report.title: 8D report of {number}
report.intro8D: The 8D for the customer, drawn from this record: change the record, and the report follows.
report.introCapa: The corrective action report, drawn from this record.
report.preview: Preview: stored nowhere until you keep a version.
report.heldReading: The report is still being made.
report.shareHint: The newest version kept is copied onto the complaint, for the customer's portal.
report.shareNone: No complaint is among its sources.
